slices.focus: A volunteer's mystery paperback recommendation starts a used-bookstore habit that deepens into a Sunday ritual
slices.summary: During a quiet work stretch, a volunteer presses a battered mystery paperback into Hannah's hands; it sparks a deepening habit of Sunday afternoon Providence used-bookstore prowls for crime novels with clipped, unsentimental, dry voices.
open_loops: Keep minimal phone note of authors + one-word descriptors (dry, fast, good ending)
Ask volunteer for one more recommendation
Keep Sundays loosely unplanned: coffee + bookstore, no pressure to buy
decisions: Hannah still reads museum case studies and narrative nonfiction, but a volunteer's recommendation has deepened her devot
